cards.meaning: slowdown; a slowing of pace (growth still positive, just slower)
cards.example: Ikalimang sunod na kwarter na ng pagbagal ng ekonomiya.
cards.exampleMeaning: It is the fifth straight quarter of economic slowdown.
cards.note: Mula sa 'bagal'. Iba sa 'pagbagsak' (talagang bumaba ang halaga). Karaniwan sa balita: pagbagal ng implasyon, pagbagal ng benta; sa usapan, 'mabagal'.
cards.tiesTo: PH Q3 GDP 2.1%, fifth straight slowdown

cards.meaning: pending; awaiting decision or action, unresolved
cards.example: Nakabinbin pa ang kaso sa Sandiganbayan.
cards.exampleMeaning: The case is still pending before the Sandiganbayan.
cards.note: Pormal at neutral (korte, Kongreso, gobyerno). Ihambing sa 'nakatengga' na may pagkainis, parang pinabayaan.

cards.meaning: willingness; inclination to act (measurable, often economic)
cards.example: 企业的借贷意愿很弱，所以贷款增长放缓。
cards.examplePinyin: Qǐyè de jièdài yìyuàn hěn ruò, suǒyǐ dàikuǎn zēngzhǎng fànghuǎn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Companies' willingness to borrow is weak, so loan growth has slowed.
cards.note: 书面语。搭配:借贷意愿、投资意愿、消费意愿、尊重…的意愿。近义词'愿望'是个人的心愿、带感情色彩;意愿 is a measurable inclination to act.
cards.tiesTo: China October credit: weak private loan demand

cards.meaning: in other words; that is to say (restates with a sharper conclusion)
cards.example: 新增贷款大幅下降，换言之，私人部门正在去杠杆。
cards.examplePinyin: Xīnzēng dàikuǎn dàfú xiàjiàng, huànyánzhī, sīrén bùmén zhèngzài qù gànggǎn.
cards.exampleMeaning: New loans fell sharply; in other words, the private sector is deleveraging.
cards.note: 连词,正式书面语(央行声明、研报、社论)。口语用'换句话说'或'也就是说'。Pattern: fact, 换言之, interpretation — adds a conclusion, not a repeat.
cards.tiesTo: China credit growth propped up by policy tools
